info.name: Troupe - Complete API Test Suite
info.description:
Comprehensive API test suite covering all 20 endpoints: health, auth, profile, feed, likes, matches, blocks, uploads, location, and notifications.

SETUP:
1. Run `npx ts-node scripts/get_test_token.ts` to generate a JWT token
2. Set the `jwtToken` variable with the generated token
3. Run requests in order within each folder (some depend on previous responses)

NOTE: Run against local server (localhost:3000) with Docker PostgreSQL only.
